# AGENTS.md — Mihak

**Identity:** a rubric-driven benchmark that compares language models on cost, latency, and explainable quality. One developer, 20 h/week.

**Docs index:** [`docs/index.md`](docs/index.md) — open only what the task needs.
**Progress of the current story:** [`docs/progress.md`](docs/progress.md) — read first, update last.
**Repo map:** `docs/repo-map.md` — generated by a script once source files exist; never hand-edit. It does not exist yet because no product code has been written.

---

## Commands

- Validate the planning data: `node scripts/validate-plan.mjs` — must pass before any planning PR.
- Regenerate the readable backlog after editing `scripts/github-data.mjs`: `node scripts/render-backlog.mjs`.
- Create the GitHub board: `node scripts/setup-project.mjs --dry-run`, then `node scripts/setup-project.mjs` (needs a token with `project` scope; store it outside the repository).
- Planned full gate after S0-1 creates the workspace: `pnpm check` = format → lint → typecheck → test → i18n. Do not invent it before the workspace exists.
- Required CI check context on `dev` and `main` is exactly `ci`. Keep that name if the workflow is renamed.

## Rules that are not obvious from the code

- **No product code yet.** The repository currently holds planning, context, and setup automation only. Product code starts with issue #1 (S0-1) on 2026-11-12. Do not create `src/`, `tests/`, or a workspace before that issue.
- **The API contract is frozen** in [`docs/planning/api-contract.md`](docs/planning/api-contract.md). A change requires one PR that updates the document, the Zod schemas in `packages/shared`, and the mock handlers together.
- **Costs are integer micro-USD (`µUSD`).** Never use floating-point dollars, and never round in the UI.
- **Scores are integers 1–5.** The judge response must be validated with a Zod schema. Invalid JSON gets one retry, then `judge_error`; the run still completes and the gap is visible.
- **A call has a 30-second timeout.** No retries, no 429 backoff, no budget cap in v0.1 — these are explicitly deferred.
- **Runs are immutable.** A finished run is never edited; a fix creates a new run.
- **Names follow [`docs/03-domain.md`](docs/03-domain.md).** Use the glossary term in code identifiers; do not invent synonyms.
- **Expected failures are values, not thrown exceptions.** Use the error codes from the API contract.
- **Timestamps are UTC.** Bilingual UI (`ar`, `en`) uses resource strings only; CSS uses logical properties, never hard-coded `left`/`right`.
- **Branch flow:** feature branches from `dev`, PRs to `dev`, release PRs `dev` → `main`. Merge commits only. No direct pushes to `dev` or `main`, even for the owner.
- **Linear history is deliberately disabled** because it contradicts the required merge commits. Do not "fix" it.
- **One story per session, on its own branch.** Plan first and wait for approval; contract → one failing test per acceptance criterion → implementation.

## Workflow

- Read `docs/index.md`, then open only the documents the task needs.
- Apply [`docs/context-order.md`](docs/context-order.md) when assembling a request to an agent: stable context first, changing context last.
- Keep a diff readable in ten minutes. If it is not, split the work by module, by migration/logic/UI, or by story.
- Review every diff with [`docs/review-checklist.md`](docs/review-checklist.md), then read the diff in the fixed order: statistics → tests → contracts → domain logic → adapters → config/dependencies.
- Turn a repeated mistake into one line here, and into a gate when possible: `finding → rule in AGENTS.md → lint rule or test`.

## Never

- Never edit an existing test to make it pass. Stop and explain why the test is wrong.
- Never add a dependency without asking.
- Never read a `.env` file, paste a token into a file or chat, or commit a credential. The GitHub token lives outside the repository at `~/.mihak/github-token`.
- Never edit an accepted ADR in place; write a new one that supersedes it.
- Never add a feature outside the six milestones. "One more feature" becomes a v0.1.1 issue, not a sprint addition.
- Never write a user-visible string in code, or a hard-coded `lang`/`dir` direction.
